text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm back~. Trainer, bestie. We managed 
somehow, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I guess I couldn't really pull off 
party-girl-style running or moves, huh~. 
Ahahaha, ha...
choice_data_list:
Can you tell me how you feel right now, 
but more like a party animal?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Like a party girl? Y-Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is totally not it, like at 
all?! A super salty debut is like, so not 
the vibe, literally no way~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Isn't it ready? Nailed it☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-ah, only if it's just the two of us, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I'm just not really used to 
being in the spotlight. Unlike Ryan and 
McQueen, who've had expectations on them 
from the start."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Just 'cause it's my Make Debut, having all 
eyes on me right away feels a bit 
overwhelming~. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulling off party-girl moves under intense 
scrutiny—that hurdle seemed to be a bit 
too high for Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Palm-chin☆ For now, let's just 
look at the blue sky♪ You can't stay in 
the dumps like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right~? There's no way we can win going 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's not it...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sounds rough, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds rough"? You mean, I look like I'm 
having a hard time?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Palmer-chin!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's way better when she's laughing, like 
when we're hanging out♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Seein' that made me feel so hyped☆ happy★ 
and excited♪ My heart was totally bouncin' 
with energy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My bestie is so much better when she's 
totally vibing! So yeah☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Life's gonna trip you up all over the 
place, so ain't the only choice to laugh 
it off? As long as we got that, we're 
totally happy-peace, right♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Besties... Helios... My... sunshine...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's true. Now's not the time to 
be thrown off by differences in 
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
First, I need to relax my shoulders and 
have fun. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fun comes first. That was precisely what 
Mejiro Palmer needed right now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, this time for sure...! So, 
Trainer, what's our next target race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I'll party even harder, and 
show everyone how to run freely!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think to myself. Having her attempt a 
party-animal stunt on a big stage sounds 
fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, instead of worrying about goal 
races, wouldn't it be better to just live 
a normal party-animal life first?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, if you enjoy yourself, your running 
gets better, and the fans blow up online 
too, right?
choice_data_list:
So you're going to win fans by living that 
party lifestyle, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gain more fans for Mejiro Palmer, who 
purely enjoys every single day. Indeed, 
that number seems directly proportional to 
how much fun she's having.
choice_data_list:
Alright, then let's start by getting more 
fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Fans? Why?
choice_data_list: Because that's the barometer of freedom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, it was important to let Mejiro 
Palmer act with lively energy. I decided 
to prioritize the process over the 
results.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy☆ Then hey Palmer-chin, come hang 
out with me and post a ton on Umastagram~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Should we make this go super viral and aim 
for a huge follower spike? How does ten 
thousand sound?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ten thousand...? Yeah, if we go completely 
wild with running and playing, maybe we 
can get somewhere close to that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's party! And ride that 
exact same wave right into the race! Let's 
enjoy both to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayyyy☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To run freely, one must first liberate 
their heart. As proof of this, she decided 
to aim for 9,000 followers [fans].
